quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the impact of playing alongside De'Aaron Fox
quotes.excerpt: it's been saving us a lot of trouble, especially over the course of the season
quotes.quote: It's been great. I think it's been saving us a lot of trouble, especially over the course of the season. Sometimes he makes things very easy for us. He's an experienced guy that we've always been able to turn to when we need it. It's easy to forget that our guards are really young and how precious he's been for them.

quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on areas for improvement in the fourth quarter
quotes.excerpt: it goes from simply not turning the ball over to being smarter about fouls
quotes.quote: There were many things. It goes from simply not turning the ball over to being smarter about fouls or even fouling earlier sometimes in the possession. It could have went a thousand ways.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on dealing with pressure as a young player
quotes.excerpt: the key is acceptance a lot of times and taking a step back
quotes.quote: I think the key is acceptance a lot of times and taking a step back, realizing the journey that's behind us and what's ahead of us, and just being okay with who I am, where I am, what I'm doing. At the end of the day, this is everything that I wish for, so there's no reason to really overthink it. This is what I'm built for.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the lessons learned from the Finals
quotes.excerpt: we need to capitalize and actually use all the efforts we did
quotes.quote: We need to capitalize and actually use all the efforts we did, because it felt like we did a lot. We did a lot of things wrong, but we also were relentless and kept pushing. We're not going to make the mistakes of the past again, but in a moment like this, we need to make these things matter.
